entities.summary: Chek Lap Kok is an island in the western waters of Hong Kong's New Territories which is home to the Hong Kong International Airport. Initially a hilly 4-square-kilometre (1.5 sq mi) island, it was flattened and greatly expanded via land reclamation into its current size of 12.48 square kilometres (4.82 sq mi) during 1992-1996 as part of the airport's construction, absorbing the nearby island of Lam Chau in the process.
